احتقنوا (form VIII)
# اِحْتَقَنُوا (iḥtaqanū) /iħ.ta.qa.nuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِحْتَقَنَ (iḥtaqana)
# اِحْتَقِنُوا (iḥtaqinū) /iħ.ta.qi.nuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِحْتَقَنَ (iḥtaqana)
